entries.levelRationale: The scientist's exclusion by colleagues is deliberate social rejection, distinct from loss of roots or belonging without an excluding agent. Provisional editorial C2-extension placement; not an official or exclusive word-level assignment.

entries.definition: Periodo o episodio breve que interrumpe temporalmente el desarrollo principal de algo.
entries.example: La tregua fue apenas un interludio entre dos campañas devastadoras.
entries.levelRationale: The truce example treats an intervening episode as a temporary interruption of a larger sequence, adding a source-supported figurative temporal function. Provisional editorial C2-extension placement; not an official or exclusive word-level assignment.
